tools.name: validate_invoice
tools.description: Full preflight of one UBL Invoice or CreditNote: XML well-formedness, UBL 2.1 XSD, the official PINT AE Schematron (≈300 rules incl. the UAE jurisdiction overlay) or the ZATCA pre-check, plus advisory cross-checks. Returns a verdict and every finding with rule id, severity, fields, location and fix

tools.name: readiness_report
tools.description: Batch preflight for a go-live check or an ERP regression suite: per-document verdicts, readiness percentage, the most frequent rejection rules across the batch, optional printable HTML. Charged per document. Response: result with verdict (ACCEPTED | ACCEPTED_WITH_WARNINGS | REJECTED), findings[] (id

tools.name: extract_summary
tools.description: Seller/buyer (names, TRN, endpoint, legal registration, emirate), dates, currency, totals, VAT breakdown, line count, payment means, attachments and the detected rule set — without validating. Free. Response: result with verdict (ACCEPTED | ACCEPTED_WITH_WARNINGS | REJECTED), findings[] (id, severit

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: Rule ids, severities and texts from the installed PINT AE Schematron (shared PINT rules and the -ae jurisdiction rules), filterable by severity or text, with fix hints where we have them. Free. Example: contains 'TaxPointDate'. Response: result with verdict (ACCEPTED | ACCEPTED_WITH_WARNINGS | REJEC

tools.name: check_trn
tools.description: Format check of a UAE Tax Registration Number (15 digits) and derivation of the TIN / Peppol participant identifier (scheme 0235 = first 10 digits). Free. Example: trn '100 1234 5670 0003'. Response: result with verdict (ACCEPTED | ACCEPTED_WITH_WARNINGS | REJECTED), findings[] (id, severity, messag

tools.name: zatca_qr_decode
tools.description: Decode the base64 TLV of a Saudi e-invoice QR into seller name, VAT number, timestamp, totals, hash, signature and key tags, with phase detection and format issues. Free. Response: result with verdict (ACCEPTED | ACCEPTED_WITH_WARNINGS | REJECTED), findings[] (id, severity, message, fields, location

tools.name: zatca_qr_encode
tools.description: Encode the five phase-1 fields (plus optional phase-2 hash/signature/key tags) into the base64 TLV string that goes into the QR image and the UBL QR reference. Free. Response: result with verdict (ACCEPTED | ACCEPTED_WITH_WARNINGS | REJECTED), findings[] (id, severity, message, fields, location, fix
